parameters.name: num_parts
parameters.description: Total number of parts in the set of parts

parameters.name: processing_cost
parameters.description: Unit processing cost for assigning each part to each machine

parameters.name: setup_cost
parameters.description: Fixed setup cost for each machine if it is used

parameters.name: capacity_m_c
parameters.description: Capacity limit on the number of parts assigned to distinguished machine m_C

parameters.name: machine_a
parameters.description: Distinguished machine label m_A for special routing rules

parameters.name: machine_b
parameters.description: Distinguished machine label m_B for special routing rules

parameters.name: machine_c
parameters.description: Distinguished machine label m_C for special routing rules

parameters.name: part_1
parameters.description: Distinguished part p^(1) for special routing rules

parameters.name: part_2
parameters.description: Distinguished part p^(2) for special routing rules

parameters.name: part_3
parameters.description: Distinguished part p^(3) that must be processed on m_A

parameters.name: part_4
parameters.description: Distinguished part p^(4) that must be processed on m_B

parameters.name: part_5
parameters.description: Distinguished part p^(5) that must be processed on m_C

variables.name: assignment
variables.description: Binary assignment variable equal to 1 if part p is assigned to machine m, and 0 otherwise

variables.name: machine_active
variables.description: Binary activation variable equal to 1 if machine m is used, and 0 otherwise

auxiliary_variables.name: total_cost
auxiliary_variables.description: Auxiliary variable representing the total objective cost for reporting and solver output

constraints.name: one_machine_per_part
constraints.description: Each part must be assigned to exactly one machine

constraints.name: machine_activation_link
constraints.description: A machine is active if and only if at least one part is assigned to it

constraints.name: conditional_routing_ab
constraints.description: If part p^(1) is assigned to m_A, then part p^(2) must be assigned to m_B or m_C

constraints.name: conditional_routing_ba
constraints.description: If part p^(1) is assigned to m_B or m_C, then part p^(2) must be assigned to m_A

constraints.name: fixed_machine_part_3
constraints.description: Part p^(3) must be processed on m_A

constraints.name: fixed_machine_part_4
constraints.description: Part p^(4) must be processed on m_B

constraints.name: fixed_machine_part_5
constraints.description: Part p^(5) must be processed on m_C

constraints.name: machine_c_capacity
constraints.description: The total number of parts assigned to m_C must not exceed the capacity limit U_C

constraints.name: explicit_part_quantity_nonuse
constraints.description: The part quantity parameter q is not used in the binary assignment model; each part is treated as a single indivisible unit assigned exactly once.
constraints.formula: \text{No constraint added: q_p is not used in the MILP formulation}

constraints.name: total_cost_definition
constraints.description: Define the reported total cost as the sum of processing and setup costs.

objectives.name: total_cost_minimization
objectives.description: Minimize the total cost consisting of processing costs and machine setup costs

final_objective.description: Minimize total processing and setup cost, and use the auxiliary total_cost variable to report the resulting objective value.
